dhikr.title: Remembrance of Allah
dhikr.description: Live audio broadcasts of Dhikr gatherings are held daily after Fajr and Maghrib/Isha, led by Hadhrat Sheikh Asif Hussain Farooqui, Daamat Barakaatuhum (UK).
dhikr.secondaryText: All are warmly welcome to attend in person or join via the live stream.
